summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral in Tehran drew millions and representatives from over 120 countries, with public calls for Trump's assassination. Israel eliminated Hamas operatives in Gaza and a Hezbollah militant in southern Lebanon. Iran-US nuclear talks are scheduled for July 11 in Pakistan.
key_points: Millions attended Khamenei's funeral in Tehran with representatives from 120+ countries; speakers publicly called for Trump's assassination as religious duty. (Source: @yediotnews25/132251)
IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in Gaza: Muhammad Najib Ashour (Nukhba platoon commander) and Tamer Said Abu Nahal (cell head). (Source: @almogboker78/17648)
IDF Brigade 551 under Division 91 eliminated an armed terrorist in Majdal Zoun, southern Lebanon, after identification in the security zone. (Source: @idf_telegram/24522)
Iran-US nuclear talks scheduled for July 11 in Islamabad, Pakistan, covering sanctions, frozen funds, and nuclear program. (Source: @pkpoi/143130)
Unknown airstrike targeted Bardi border area in Kirkuk Province, Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/7377)
UK Maritime Trade Operations reported commercial vessel attacked near Hodeidah port, Yemen by unknown armed attackers. (Source: @pkpoi/143138)
IRGC naval boats diverted 6 vessels from the Omani corridor; 2 redirected to Iranian route, 4 returned to Persian Gulf. (Source: @SharghDaily/169969)
Iranian Army spokesperson warned of powerful response if enemies err, stating ceasefire used to improve combat capabilities. (Source: @yediotnews25/132261)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral in Tehran drew millions and representatives from over 120 countries, with public calls for Trump's assassination. Israel eliminated Hamas operatives in Gaza and a Hezbollah militant in southern Lebanon. Iran-US nuclear talks are scheduled for July 11 in Pakistan.

points: Khamenei's funeral in Tehran drew millions of mourners and representatives from over 120 countries; state media aired aerial footage of the massive crowds at Musalla and surrounding streets. (Source: @kianmeli1/88304, @pkpoi/143129)

Speakers at the funeral publicly called for Trump's assassination, declaring it a religious duty: "Why should we not kill the man who killed my imam? Trump's assassination is our duty." (Source: @yediotnews25/132251, @Faytuks_Network/4600)

Iranian security forces prevented Mojtaba Khamenei from attending his father's burial in Mashhad due to fears Israel would exploit his public appearance for assassination or tracking. (Source: @pkpoi/143131)

Iranian Army spokesperson declared: "If enemies err, they will face a powerful and decisive response; we use the ceasefire to improve combat capabilities and waste no moment." (Source: @yediotnews25/132261)

IRGC naval forces intercepted 6 vessels in the Omani corridor; Windward AI data shows 2 ships diverted to Iranian route, 4 returned to Persian Gulf, coinciding with IRGC patrol boat presence and radio warnings. (Source: @SharghDaily/169969)
Iran-Qatar maritime trade resumed via Al-Ruwais port after 5-month stoppage following Iranian embassy coordination with Qatari officials. (Source: @SharghDaily/169979)
Trump warned he could target regime officials at Khamenei's ceremony but gave a week for burial before nuclear talks. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74732)

IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in Gaza: Muhammad Najib Ashour, Nukhba platoon commander in Hamas military wing, and Tamer Said Abu Nahal, cell head in Hamas military wing, both advancing terror plots against Israeli forces. (Source: @almogboker78/17648, @yediotnews25/132260)

IDF Brigade 551 under Division 91 identified and eliminated an armed terrorist in the security zone near Majdal Zoun, southern Lebanon after pursuit and extensive searches. (Source: @idf_telegram/24522)
Netanyahu spoke with Trump during Sabbath; both agreed to meet in US next week. (Source: @pkpoi/143129)
Mossad Persian channel tweeted during Khamenei funeral that Israeli-US technology "that eliminated Khamenei" now serves his supporters. (Source: @New_security8200/202219)
IDF confirmed elimination of two Hamas operatives in Gaza involved in advancing terror plots against Israeli forces via precise strikes. (Source: @yediotnews25/132260, @almogboker78/17648)
No additional West Bank operations reported in the provided messages.
IDF eliminated armed terrorist in Majdal Zoun security zone, southern Lebanon, by Brigade 551 under Division 91 after identification, pursuit, and searches. (Source: @idf_telegram/24522)

Lebanese Army conducted controlled explosion in Al-Sama'iyya town. (Source: @redlinkleb/29984)
Residents of confrontation line communities urged Netanyahu and Finance Minister to approve tax benefits before Knesset recess. (Source: @almogboker78/17647)
Unknown airstrike targeted Bardi border area in Kirkuk Province, Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/7377)
Iraqi Counter-Terrorism Service reported martyrdom of Lt. Hassan Khudhayr Zughayr during clashes with ISIS in Kirkuk Province. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81054)
OPEC+ 7 countries decided to increase oil production by 188,000 bpd in August. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81066)
Iran-Qatar maritime trade resumed via Al-Ruwais port after 5-month stoppage. (Source: @SharghDaily/169979)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of Khamenei's funeral with explicit assassination threats against Trump creates immediate escalation risk. Iran's military vow to respond powerfully to any error, combined with IRGC naval assertiveness in the Gulf, signals readiness for confrontation. Israel's simultaneous operations in Gaza and Lebanon demonstrate continued pressure on Iranian proxies. The scheduled July 11 Iran-US talks in Pakistan represent a critical diplomatic off-ramp, but Trump's one-week ultimatum and threats to target regime officials undermine negotiation prospects. The unknown airstrike in Kirkuk and ISIS activity in Iraq add further instability.
sections.regional_response: Qatar restored maritime trade with Iran via Al-Ruwais port after five months, signaling Gulf pragmatic engagement. OPEC+ production increase of 188,000 bpd reflects market management amid tensions. Lebanese Army conducted controlled explosion in Al-Sama'iyya while RedLinkLeb data shows persistent Israeli drone surveillance (170 sightings) with minimal kinetic action. Iraqi Counter-Terrorism Service continues anti-ISIS operations in Kirkuk. Regional actors appear to be hedging between de-escalation diplomacy and military preparedness.
sections.intelligence_notes: Mojtaba Khamenei's exclusion from burial suggests Iranian leadership anticipates Israeli targeting of succession figures. Mossad's Persian-language psychological operation during the funeral indicates Israeli intelligence confidence in penetration. Windward's satellite-AI correlation of IRGC boat movements with vessel route changes provides actionable maritime intelligence. The 0% targeting rate despite 170 drone detections in Lebanon suggests Israeli rules of engagement restraint or technical limitations. Trump's public threat timeline (one week post-burial) creates a measurable decision window for Iran.
